squares.label: FOI / EIR request
squares.law: FOIA s.1; EIR reg 5

squares.label: Subject access request
squares.law: UK GDPR Art 15; DPA 2018 s.45

squares.label: Redirected to the holder
squares.law: FOIA s.16 advice; s.21 / EIR reg 6(1)(b) reasonably accessible elsewhere

squares.label: Clarified or narrowed
squares.law: FOIA s.1(3); EIR reg 9(2)

squares.label: Statutory deadline
squares.law: FOIA s.10: 20 working days; EIR reg 5(2); SAR: one month, UK GDPR Art 12(3)

squares.label: Reply received
squares.law: FOIA s.1(1); s.17 refusal notice

squares.label: Chaser
squares.law: the working day after a lapsed deadline

squares.label: Internal review asked
squares.law: FOIA s.45 Code of Practice para 5; EIR reg 11; SAR: complaint to the controller

squares.label: Review outcome
squares.law: 20 working days (s.45 Code para 5.5); 40 working days (EIR reg 11(4))

squares.label: Formal complaint
squares.law: the body's own complaints procedure

squares.label: Complaint response
squares.law: the body's complaints procedure; MP or Senedd member may intervene

squares.label: ICO complaint
squares.law: FOIA s.50; EIR reg 18; DPA 2018 s.165

squares.label: ICO investigation
squares.law: FOIA s.50(2); information notice s.51

squares.label: ICO decision notice
squares.law: FOIA s.50(3)(b); SAR: ICO outcome

squares.label: Ombudsman
squares.law: PSOW (Public Services Ombudsman (Wales) Act 2019) / LGSCO / PHSO / Independent Complaints Reviewer for HM Land Registry

squares.label: Ombudsman report
squares.law: ombudsman investigation report and recommendations

squares.label: First-tier Tribunal appeal
squares.law: FOIA s.57; GRC Rules r.22: 28 days; SAR: DPA 2018 s.166 order to progress

squares.label: Tribunal hearing
squares.law: Tribunal Procedure (First-tier Tribunal) (General Regulatory Chamber) Rules 2009

squares.label: Tribunal decision
squares.law: FOIA s.58

squares.label: Upper Tribunal appeal
squares.law: Tribunals, Courts and Enforcement Act 2007 s.11 (point of law, with permission)

squares.label: Upper Tribunal decision
squares.law: TCEA 2007 s.12

squares.label: Pre-action letter
squares.law: Practice Direction Pre-Action Conduct; Pre-Action Protocol for Judicial Review

squares.label: Pre-action disclosure application
squares.law: CPR 31.16 / Senior Courts Act 1981 s.33(2)

squares.label: Non-party disclosure application
squares.law: CPR 31.17 / Senior Courts Act 1981 s.34(2)

squares.label: Disclosure order
squares.law: court order for disclosure and inspection (CPR 31.16(4), 31.17(4))

squares.label: Court
squares.law: Administrative Court judicial review (CPR 54); DPA 2018 s.167 compliance order

squares.label: Trigger event found
squares.law: SOP: dishonest evidence in 1986–87, a concealed record, or government involvement

squares.label: Logged, preserved and hashed
squares.law: SOP S1–S2: custody log, original kept, sha256

squares.label: Record verified
squares.law: SOP Gate 1: independent check against its source

squares.label: Lawyer instructed
squares.law: SOP S5: public access barrister or solicitor

squares.label: Legal opinion
squares.law: SOP Gate 2: which test is met, which route, which deadline

squares.label: Letter before action
squares.law: SOP S7; Practice Direction Pre-Action Conduct

squares.label: Route chosen
squares.law: SOP Gate 3: CPR 52.30 reopening · set aside (Takhar v Gracefield [2019] UKSC 13) · Limitation Act 1980 s.32 · Strasbourg

squares.label: Permission
squares.law: CPR 52.30(4)–(6): permission to reopen a final appeal

squares.label: Rehearing
squares.law: the appeal reheard, or the 1987 judgment set aside and retried

squares.label: Case reopened
squares.law: BP Properties Ltd v Buckler [1987] EWCA Civ 2 reopened

ladders.label: Full disclosure by the deadline
ladders.effect: No internal review needed: the material moves the case on to the next route.

ladders.label: Body concedes at internal review
ladders.law: FOIA s.45 Code para 5; EIR reg 11(4)
ladders.effect: The review releases the information, so the ICO stage is skipped.

ladders.label: Record disclosed that engages Limitation Act s.32
ladders.law: Limitation Act 1980 s.32(1)(b): time runs from discovery of deliberate concealment
ladders.effect: Straight to the trigger-event SOP and the reopen routes.

ladders.label: MP or Ombudsman intervention
ladders.law: Public Services Ombudsman (Wales) Act 2019; Parliamentary Commissioner Act 1967 (MP referral)
ladders.effect: An intervention gets the answer without the full complaint cycle.

ladders.label: ICO decision notice in our favour
ladders.law: FOIA s.50(4): steps to take within 35 days; non-compliance certified to the court under s.54
ladders.effect: The tribunal stage is not needed.

ladders.label: Pre-action disclosure ordered
ladders.law: CPR 31.16(3) test met; Senior Courts Act 1981 s.33(2)
ladders.effect: The record comes out through the court and goes straight to verification.

ladders.label: Fresh evidence admitted
ladders.effect: The opinion can go straight to a route.

snakes.label: Refused as vexatious or repeated
snakes.law: FOIA s.14(1) vexatious; s.14(2) repeated request; EIR reg 12(4)(b) manifestly unreasonable

snakes.label: Cost limit, or clarification asked
snakes.law: FOIA s.12 (appropriate limit £450 / £600, 18 / 24 hours); FOIA s.1(3) clarification
snakes.effect: A narrower request starts the clock again.

snakes.label: Out of time for the ICO
snakes.law: FOIA s.50(2)(b) undue delay; DPA 2018 s.165
snakes.effect: The ICO declines; back to the chaser and a fresh review.

snakes.label: Information not held
snakes.law: FOIA s.1(1)(a); EIR reg 12(4)(a); decided on the balance of probabilities (Bromley v IC EA/2006/0072)
snakes.effect: Back to finding the body that holds it.

snakes.label: Neither confirm nor deny
snakes.law: FOIA s.1(1)(a) disapplied, e.g. s.23(5), s.30(3), s.40(5)
snakes.effect: The FOI route closes; back to the complaints route.

snakes.label: Out of time for the Tribunal
snakes.law: GRC Rules r.22(1)(b): 28 days from the decision notice; r.5(3)(a) extension at discretion
snakes.effect: The decision notice stands; back to the chaser.

snakes.label: Permission to reopen refused
snakes.effect: Back to court disclosure for the next record.

snakes.label: Set-aside test not met
snakes.law: Takhar v Gracefield [2019] UKSC 13; Royal Bank of Scotland v Highland Financial Partners [2013] EWCA Civ 328 para 106
snakes.effect: Back to counsel for another route.
